black face bug.fix: Ensure NPC overhaul mods have proper facegen data. Run CK or use a bashed patch. Check load order with LOOT.

t-pose.fix: Run FNIS or Nemesis after installing animation mods. Ensure XP32 skeleton is loaded last in animations.

t pose.fix: Run FNIS or Nemesis after installing animation mods. Ensure XP32 skeleton is loaded last in animations.

ctd loading.fix: Check Papyrus logs. Common causes: corrupt saves, script overload, or missing masters. Try disabling ENB.

missing textures.fix: Run BodySlide and Outfit Studio. Ensure texture mods are activated and not overwritten by a blank mod.

npc sin cara.fix: Verifica que los mods de overhaul de NPCs tengan facegen correcto. Usa LOOT para ordenar el load order.

cara negra.fix: Asegurate que los mods de NPCs esten en el orden correcto. Regenera facegen si es necesario.

crash al entrar.fix: Revisa los logs de Papyrus. Deshabilita ENB temporalmente para diagnosticar.
